ideas.title: The $8k Employee You Already Fired
ideas.concept: A myth-bust style post exposing the hidden cost of manual admin work. Visual would be a mock 'employment contract' with line items like 'copy-pasting leads: 4hrs/week', 'chasing invoices: 3hrs/week', totaling to a shocking annual cost — with a red 'TERMINATED' stamp across it.
ideas.hook: You're paying an $8,000/year salary to an employee who doesn't exist.

ideas.title: I Asked Claude To Audit My Inbox. It Found 6 Hours.
ideas.concept: A tool breakdown post showing exactly how Claude AI + Google Workspace can categorise, draft replies, and flag priority emails. Visual is a split screen: chaotic inbox on the left, a clean dashboard with AI-drafted replies on the right, with time-saved counter ticking up.
ideas.hook: Your inbox isn't a to-do list. It's a tax on your attention.

ideas.title: The Plumber Who Books Jobs While He Sleeps
ideas.concept: A short case study / story post about a trades client using N8N + GoHighLevel to auto-qualify leads, send quotes, and book jobs overnight. Visual: a phone screenshot showing 3 new bookings confirmed between 11pm and 6am, with a caption 'while he was asleep'.
ideas.hook: He woke up to 3 booked jobs. He didn't answer a single call.

ig_caption:
He spent 6 months and £4,200 building an automation that broke every Tuesday. 🧨

His setup? Zapier stacked on spreadsheets, glued together with ChatGPT prompts and prayer.

Every Tuesday, a Zap timed out. Leads vanished. Invoices duplicated. His VA spent hours cleaning up the mess.

We rebuilt it in 9 days: N8N running the logic, GoHighLevel handling the CRM, Claude doing the thinking.

Zero breakages in 4 months. He got his Tuesdays back.

Cheap automation isn't cheap. It's the most expensive tax you'll ever pay.

Sound familiar? 👇
